research_rationale:
EO 12511 (President's Child Safety Partnership), signed 1985-04-29. The order establishes the President's Child Safety Partnership of not more than 26 members (Section 1), its functions, with a final report due by April 29, 1987 (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). First end: Section 4(c) of the order provides that the Partnership shall terminate on April 29, 1987, or 60 days after submitting its final report, whichever is earlier. The fixed date is the latest date on which the Partnership could end, so I record 1987-04-29 as the first end by the order's own terms (read inclusively: the Partnership exists through April 29, 1987). The report-relative alternative could have ended it earlier; the held packet has no dated record of the final report, so that possibility is disclosed and no earlier date is claimed. Section 3(d) of EO 12610 later revoked the order, effective September 30, 1987, which is after the sunset and is a later event.
